name: The Guide, classic lines (unofficial fan pack)

notes.text: Mostly harmless.
The local dominant lifeforms still think digital watches are a pretty neat idea.
A planet where the population is so unhappy that they invented a currency system based on the movement of small green pieces of paper.
Zaphod Beeblebrox drank near here. Twice. Simultaneously.
The ultimate destination for people who want to watch the universe end while eating a steak that actively wants to be eaten.
Do not order the Pan Galactic Gargle Blaster unless your brain insurance is fully paid up.
Ford Prefect still owes a bar tab here dating back to the pre-destruction era.
Rated 1 out of 5 stars by the Sirius Cybernetics Corporation (which means it’s probably lovely).
If you see a Vogon constructor fleet, do not under any circumstances ask them to read their poetry.
The probability of surviving a jump through this sector is 2 to the power of 276,709 against. Enjoy your flight.
Space is big. You just won't believe how vastly, hugely, mind-bogglingly big it is.
Do not panic. Unless you forgot your towel, in which case, panic immediately.
Home of the Ravenous Bugblatter Beast of Traal. If you can’t see it, it thinks it can’t see you.
Your ship's computer is currently feeling very depressed. Please treat it with kindness, or it might turn off the life support.
The Infinite Improbability Drive is currently warming up. Expect your shoes to turn into marmalade shortly.
Warning: The automatic doors have been upgraded with a GPP (Genuine People Personality). They are far too cheerful for this time of day.
Nutri-Matic Drink Dispenser: Currently producing something that is almost, but not quite, entirely unlike tea.
The answer is 42. We are still trying to figure out what the question was.
The local government is run by a man in a shack who doesn't believe anything is real. He’s doing a fantastic job.
A perfectly normal system. Move along, nothing to see here, definitely no secret hyper-spatial bypasses.
The local sun is currently sponsored by the Sirius Cybernetics Corporation.
Eccentrica Gallumbits once hosted a party so wild, the Infinite Improbability Drive registered it as a predictable Tuesday.
Galactic cartographers had to officially classify Eccentrica Gallumbits personal space as a major interstellar tourist destination.
Eccentrica Gallumbits remains the only living being capable of making a Vogon completely forget about his paperwork.
A sperm whale once fell from the sky here thinking, "I wonder if it will be friends with me?"
A bowl the petunias once fell from the sky here and just thought, "Oh no, not again."
If a whale can manage to reconcile its own existence, velocity, and tail-flapping in under two minutes, you really have no excuse for failing your starship navigation exam.
Experts agree that the probability of a sperm whale spontaneously materializing in an atmosphere is exactly equal to the probability of the universe proving it makes any sense at all.
Highly advanced civilization. Completely undone by a sudden shortage of phone sanitisers.
A planet entirely populated by middle-managers who were exiled from a sensible planet three million years ago.
The local language has 42 different words for "Oops."
Warning: The local stellar core is currently sponsored by the Sirius Cybernetics Corporation. Expect unskippable solar flares.
Warning: A perfectly normal system. Move along, nothing to see here, definitely no illegal hyper-spatial bypasses.
Warning: This system’s hyper-spatial bypass was built upside down. If you exit the jump lane feeling like your feet are in your mouth, this is normal.
Warning: A rogue Vogon filing cabinet is currently adrift in this system. Collision will result in catastrophic structural damage and immediate auditing.
